verses.text: He who forms the mountains, who creates the wind . . . the Lord God Almighty is his name.
verses.title: Grateful for God’s Discipline

verses.text: Spiritual Fullness in Christ So then, just as you received Christ Jesus as Lord, continue to live your lives in him, rooted and built up in him, strengthened in the faith as you were taught, and overflowing with thankfulness.
But thanks be to God! He gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
